name: Kamuro
source:
His age is unknown.

A celestial being who represents the Heavenly Realm, and the main culprit who helped the prisoners of Hell escape. Close enough to the heroine to call her by a nickname. Adored by his pet, Kukuri, who sits on his shoulder.

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/tengoku/characters/kamuro/]Aksys Games[/url]]
